description: Get recent news articles for a specific stock ticker symbol. Articles are sourced from Google News and other financial news aggregators. Returns article titles, publication dates, source names, and URLs. Covers US-listed symbols only (non-US listings such as 9988.HK or 000660.KS are not available). If the ticker is not yet tracked, the system will automatically fetch and index its news on first request (may take a few seconds).

limit.description: Number of articles to return (1-20). Default: 15

name: get_stock_news
